violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: Observed raw marinated chicken stored above the different types of sauces and yogurt.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC placed raw marinated chicken below aforementioned ready-to-eat food.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: Dishwashing machine was observed with a sanitizing rinse concentration of less than 0ppm chlorine. The dish-ware is not properly sanitized.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. PIC discontinued use the dish machine and set up 3 compartment sink for properly sanitizing dish-ware. PIC properly sanitized the dish-ware.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter. Observed wet wiping cloths used for placement under cutting boards at kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. PIC placed wiping cloth in sanitizer solution.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Observed utensils in-use stored in a water container at the bar with the water temperature at 71.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EHS instructed PIC on proper storage of food utensils in food preparation area. PIC removed utensils from the water container and properly cleaned and sanitized them.

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: observed raw chicken sitting in a pot on the prep table at room temperature.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. EHS discussed proper thawing methods with the PIC. PIC moved the raw chicken to the WIC for proper thawing.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: The hand sink basin at the kitchen is slow to drain.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. Please provide the repair and send proof of repair to EHS once the repair is completed.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the gasket at the delivery door is torn and need of repair or replacement.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. PIC will email proof of repair to EHS once the repair is completed.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: working containers of all type of spices, squeeze bottles of oil, vinegar and etc stored on cook line and throughout establishment.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. PIV PIC labeled all working containers and squeeze bottles during the inspection.

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There are no quaternary ammonia sanitizing solution test kit for the dispensing sanitizing solution and no chlorine sanitizing solution test kit for the dishwasher available in the facility to monitor the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions.
violations.corrective_action: PIC purchased a bleach and quaternary ammonia test kits during the inspection.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed no approved splitter attached to the faucet of mop sink.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. PIC disconnected the no approved splitter from the faucet of mop sink.
